title: Alex's Upgrade Package
description: Think of this as like... a Free DLC for Minecraft.
body:
Ever since i was a lil kid i was like "wouldnt it be cool if i made my own mod?" and about ten years later (and messing with Mcreator to make it go as Professionally as ever) i have made this... Thing. Bear in mind it's just a passion project, so expect less "Super Mega Content Mod" and more "Remember Davoleo's MEtallurgy? yeah that"
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
What to Expect:

- Emerald Alloy: Gold and Emeralds turned into this mod's iconic material
- Copper Tools, including a knife that can be used as Shears
- Zinc, the Decorative Metal
- Osmium, Titanium, Steel, Brass, and more to come
- Exotic crystals, and the such
- the Omniblades: Sword-Like Multitools that give you each a special couple of effects when in the off-hand
- and more...
